subject: SIG + ISO27001: Evidence logistics and short mutual action plan
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@solsticebank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@solsticebank.com>, Solstice Bank Security <security@solsticebank.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: SIG + ISO27001 evidence request — Redwood Inference

Markus —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement has asked us to complete a SIG questionnaire and validate a small set of ISO27001 scope items before we move to the legal redline stage. I attached the Solstice SIG questionnaire (v3) with a few high-priority control families called out in the cover sheet.

Our asks (high level):
- Completed SIG spreadsheet for sections: Access Management, Data Protection, Vendor Mgmt (we'll prioritize 40 controls).
- ISO27001: scope confirmation and copy of certificate + Statement of Applicability for in-scope systems (specifically inference runtime and control plane).
- Evidence samples: account provisioning review log, KMS key rotation entries for the last 6 months, and a recent SOC 2 Type II summary if available.

Can you confirm a target turnaround? We have an internal compliance checkpoint week of 5/24 and would like Redwood's artifacts by EOD 5/21 if possible. If that's too tight, proposed alternate deadlines are fine but please call out any items that will take longer (e.g., legal redactions, third-party attestations).

Thanks — happy to set a short call if needed.

Dana Liu
Senior Security Analyst | Solstice Bank
security@solsticebank.com

Attachments: Solstice_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@solsticebank.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@solsticebank.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG + ISO27001 evidence request — Redwood Inference

Dana —

Appreciate the clear asks and the priority flags. We can meet most of the items by 2027-05-21 EOD with a small exception: the full SOC 2 Type II report is governed by our external auditor NDA and usually requires a controlled release; we can provide a SOC 2 summary and auditor contact, and we will coordinate a controlled disclosure of the full report under your compliance NDA.

Quick plan (mutual action plan):
1) Today (5/16) — Redwood: return a partially completed SIG response matrix (attached) with answers for high-priority controls + list of remaining controls requiring artifact collection.
2) 5/18 — Redwood: upload ISO27001 scope doc and SoA excerpt; provide KMS rotation export and access-review sample.
3) 5/21 EOD — Redwood: target delivery of completed responses for prioritized 40 controls + SOC 2 summary.
4) If Solstice needs the full SOC 2: execute mutual NDA / auditor access (expect 3–5 business days once paperwork is done).

I'm looping Priya (security & compliance) and Ben (solutions engineering) to collect and package the artifacts. Priya/Ben — see inline action items.

If that timeline works for you, I'll mark deliverables and share a Drive folder link for secure artifact handoff.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Response_Matrix_partial.xlsx
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-16T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: Solstice SIG/ISO artifacts — owners + commit dates

Priya / Ben —

Looping you both to help fulfill the MAP I promised to Solstice. Thread copied below for context. Please treat this as time-sensitive — Solstice procurement is gating legal and we want to avoid extra review cycles.

Priya (owners: security evidence, SoA, SOC summary):
- Deliverable: ISO27001_Scope_and_Certs.pdf (cert + scope statement excerpt) — due 2027-05-18 EOD.
- Deliverable: access review sample (redacted) and KMS_rotation_log_excerpt.csv — due 2027-05-18 EOD.
- Note: if any evidence requires redaction for PII or third-party secrets, flag it and provide redaction justification.

Ben (owner: SIG control responses, tech substantiation):
- Deliverable: completed answers for prioritized 40 controls in Redwood_SIG_Response_Matrix_partial.xlsx — due 2027-05-21 EOD.
- Deliverable: short tech writeups for controls tied to inference runtime (batching, KV cache, token retention policy) — due 2027-05-20.

Also: I'll set up a Drive folder and a DocuSign envelope template for the limited-disclosure NDA the auditor will need. If either of you foresee blockers (e.g., auditor process, legal redactions, missing logs), call it out in a reply with ETA.

Thanks — Mark
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@solsticebank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@solsticebank.com>, Solstice Bank Security <security@solsticebank.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG + ISO27001 evidence request — Redwood Inference

Markus —

Thanks for the clear MAP and for looping your team. Procurement confirms the 5/21 soft deadline for the prioritized controls. A few clarifications from Security:
- We only need the KMS rotation audit entries that show automated rotations and the last manual rotation event (audit trail is fine). Redactions are acceptable for key IDs.
- For SOC 2 summary: a cover page summary and auditor contact is sufficient for our initial review; we will request full report under NDA if material gaps appear.
- Please label any vendor-scope statements (e.g., "Redwood control scope excludes managed partner GPU infra X") so our risk team can map boundaries.

If you upload artifacts to the Drive link you share, please set comments-only access for anyone outside Redwood. If DocuSign is needed for the auditor NDA, we can accept that.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We may still ask for one short call on 5/21 to walk through the runtime-specific answers (should be 30 minutes).

Best,
Dana
Senior Security Analyst | Solstice Bank
